items.prompt: Why inspect input symmetry even if a library Cholesky call succeeds?

options.text: Success always proves every input triangle was checked
options.why: Some routines consume only a selected triangle.

options.text: Every asymmetric matrix is a valid covariance
The upper and lower entries have unrelated meanings
options.why: They must agree for the intended real symmetric matrix.

options.text: The routine may not check the unused triangle
options.why: Validate the intended full matrix under a declared numerical policy.

items.explanation: The API can return a factor for the selected triangle while inconsistent entries elsewhere go unnoticed.
